subject: [PATCH v4 06/14] SUNRPC: report local rpcbind calls that get no answer

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch modifies the SUNRPC code to report local rpcbind calls that receive no answer, allowing callers to distinguish between failures due to a non-responsive rpcbind and other types of errors. The patch introduces new error codes to categorize rpcbind call failures into three groups: answered (with a specific set of error codes), never sent (with a different set of error codes), and no answer (all remaining error codes). A count of unanswered rpcbind calls is also maintained in the serv structure, which will be used by later patches to adjust behavior based on hard rpcbind failures.
